# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Gather information immediately from witnesses and involved employees.
3. Document the date, time, and location of the incident.
4. Describe the sequence of events leading up to the accident, how it happened, and its immediate aftermath.
5. Note all injuries, property damage, and equipment involved.
6. Identify any contributing factors, such as environmental conditions, personal protective equipment use, safety procedures followed/not followed, etc.
7. Record statements from the injured employee(s) and from witnesses.
8. Include photos or sketches of the accident scene if possible.
9. Document the type and severity of injuries and medical treatment provided.
10. Note any immediate corrective actions taken.
11. Report the incident to appropriate personnel and agencies according to your organizational policy and legal requirements.
12. Secure all evidence related to the accident for potential investigation.
13. Maintain confidentiality of all personal and sensitive information to only those who need to know.
14. Keep a clear and accurate paper trail
